package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/relationorder"
)

// AddCourseModuleInput contains a course-module relation.
type AddCourseModuleInput struct {
	CourseID string
	ModuleID string
	Order    int
}

// AddCourseModule links an existing module to a course.
type AddCourseModule struct {
	Courses       repository.CourseRepository
	Modules       repository.ModuleRepository
	CourseModules repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Tx            repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc AddCourseModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, in AddCourseModuleInput) error {
	if in.CourseID == "" || in.ModuleID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, in.ModuleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.CourseModules.Add(ctx, in.CourseID, in.ModuleID, in.Order)
	})
}

// DeleteCourseModule removes a course-module relation without deleting the module.
type DeleteCourseModule struct {
	Courses       repository.CourseRepository
	Modules       repository.ModuleRepository
	CourseModules repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Tx            repository.TransactionManager
}

// ReplaceCourseModules atomically replaces the complete ordered module set of
// one course.
type ReplaceCourseModules struct {
	Courses       repository.CourseRepository
	Modules       repository.ModuleRepository
	CourseModules repository.CourseModuleRepository
	Tx            repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceCourseModules) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	courseID, items, err := relationorder.Normalize(courseID, items)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, item.ChildID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.CourseModules.ReplaceByCourse(ctx, courseID, items)
	})
}

func (uc DeleteCourseModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string, moduleID string) error {
	if courseID == "" || moduleID == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, moduleID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.CourseModules.Delete(ctx, courseID, moduleID)
	})
}
